environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on ECS Fargate in us-east-1 VPC. S3 access goes through a standard NAT gateway to the public S3 endpoint. IAM role attached to the task has s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::app-profiles-prod/*. No input validation middleware, no VPC endpoint for S3.

config.s3_access: via NAT gateway to public S3 endpoint
config.network: no VPC endpoint, no S3 access restrictions beyond IAM
